exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

Enya drifting through a summer playlist

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap on the off-beat gaps in a stutter-house loop — missed beats glitch the track louder until you find the pocket again.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 30s round is one perfect drop build from silence to peak.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and stutter density doubles every 10 seconds.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw copper traces between floating component pins before the schematic sheet auto-scrolls — short circuits flash and reset your chain.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Complete three clean routes before the zoom-out reveals the whole board.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Pins multiply and scroll speed increases as traces tangle.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: green PCB grid on cream paper

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Steer a kite through three fog lanes as summer wind gusts push you toward power lines — hold lane, release to snap back center.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Survive one gust cycle and land the kite on the rooftop.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Gust frequency rises and lanes drift wider apart.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick sparks upward to detonate color clusters in an overcast sky — chain reactions score combos before embers fade.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: One birthday barrage — max combo in 45 seconds.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind shears sparks sideways and clusters shrink each wave.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: chalk pastel bursts on slate gray
